title: Leads board and list — filters, year, CSV

steps.expect: One column per stage; each lead appears once.
steps.observed: One column per stage (New enquiry, Contact made, Qualified); 8 TB test leads, none twice.

steps.expect: Only leads created in that FY.
steps.observed: FY 2025-26 → only the leads created in that year: TB FY25 India, TB FY25 Hotel, TB FY25 Golf, TB FY25 Foxtrot.
All years → every lead (all 10 test leads, including the two closed ones).

steps.expect: A file downloads with the same rows as on screen.
steps.observed: Downloaded leads-all-years-2026-11-15.csv with the same 10 test leads as the screen.
steps.note: The "⬇ CSV" was pressed on the List view with All years; the board view's CSV holds the board's own leads (commit "Leads board CSV holds the board's own leads").

steps.do: Sign in as Test KAM (Mumbai branch).
steps.expect: Ahmedabad leads are NOT shown; leads with no branch are shown to everyone.
steps.observed: Test KAM sees the Mumbai leads and "TB FY26 NoBranch"; no Ahmedabad lead.
